pages.title: Blacksburg
pages.extract: Blacksburg is a moderate-sized town in Southwest Virginia and is home of Virginia Tech (full name: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University).

pages.title: Gresham
pages.description: city in Multnomah County, Oregon, United States of America
pages.extract:
Gresham is the fourth largest city within the state of Oregon, with a population of 114,000 in 2020.  It's the home of an annual jazz festival.  It is a part of the Portland Metropolitan Area and is generally considered a Portland suburb.
The downtown area of Gresham can be easily missed by those driving along W Powell Blvd, but has a handful of restaurants and shops to offer, as well as Main City Park.

pages.title: Shelburne (Massachusetts)
pages.description: town in Franklin County, Massachusetts, United States of America
pages.extract: Shelburne is a town in Franklin County, in the Pioneer Valley region of Massachusetts.  It includes the village of Shelburne Falls.

pages.title: Southern Indiana
pages.description: cultural region of the U.S. state of Indiana
pages.extract: Southern Indiana is a region of the state of Indiana in the United States.

pages.title: Tehran
pages.extract: Tehran (also spelled Teheran)  (Persian: تهران), is the capital city of Iran. A bustling metropolis of 14 million people, it sits at the foot of the towering Alborz mountain range. Tehran is a cosmopolitan city, with great museums, parks, restaurants, and warm friendly people. It deserves at least a few days of your Iranian itinerary.

pages.title: Anamalai Tiger Reserve
pages.extract: Anamalai Tiger Reserve is a national park near Pollachi in the state of Tamil Nadu, India, at an altitude of 800 feet from the sea level on the Anamalai mountain range. It is a part of the protected Indira Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary. Topslip is blessed with a gentle altitude, salubrious climate and a variety of flora and fauna. Its picturesque location and fabulous scenery has made it a popular location for several movie sequences. It stands majestically with Green Spread Mountains and forest all around. It is a Project Elephant sanctuary and a Project Tiger sanctuary. The local administrative control is with the Forest Range Officer under supervision from the Wildlife Warden at Pollachi.

pages.title: Music in Britain and Ireland
pages.description: overview of musical traditions in the British Isles
pages.extract: Britain and Ireland have a rich heritage of music, from folk songs, through classical music, to pop genres such as rock, grime, and electronic music.

pages.title: Cadgwith
pages.extract: Cadgwith (Cornish: Porthkajwydh) is a small fishing village in West Cornwall, on the Lizard Peninsula between The Lizard and Coverack. Cadgwith has long been popular as a holiday destination, especially during the summer when there are numerous local events: gig racing days, summer barbecues, a regatta, Morris dancing, musical bands, and regular singing by the Cadgwith Singers in the public house. The South West Coast Path traverses the village.

pages.title: Werakata National Park
pages.description: National Park in New South Wales, Australia
pages.extract: Werakata National Park is a national park in the Hunter region of New South Wales. In the 1800s when European settlers came, most of this park was destroyed due to the large scale timber industry. Forestry commenced and sawmills were established in and near area the area of the park (most of the timber going to local mines for pit props). The park now remains as a measure to protect what is left.

pages.title: Fugar

pages.extract: Fugar is in South South Nigeria.

pages.title: Ráquira
pages.description: Colombian municipality of the department of Boyacá
pages.extract: Ráquira is a small town in Boyacá known for its Sunday artisan market with traditional northern Andean pottery & hand-woven goods.

pages.title: Hooghly (district)
pages.extract: Hooghly (হুগলি Hugli or হুগলী Huglī) is a district of West Bengal, India. It borders Purba Bardhaman to the north, Nadia and North 24 Parganas to the east, Howrah to the south, Paschim Medinipur to the southwest, and Bankura to the northwest.

pages.title: Booti Booti National Park
pages.description: National Park in New South Wales, Australia
pages.extract: Booti Booti National Park (Worimi: Butibuti) is a coastal national park on New South Wales' Mid-North Coast. It lies between two bodies of water and offers plenty to see and do, making it a popular holiday spot for families with children and those simply seeking to go out and relax.

pages.title: Târgu Lăpuș
pages.extract: Târgu Lăpuș is a town in Maramureș on the northwestern edge of the Transylvanian Plateau, at the foot of the Lăpuș Mountains. It lies on the banks of the river Lăpuș
